subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should repair intake permanently require versioned Gitcrawl evidence, quarantine legacy jobs, and support local, cloud, and strict parity providers under the stacked action-ledger contract?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but it intentionally changes accepted persisted-job behavior and commits maintainers to an external provider and fail-closed operations model.

options.title: Approve strict contract
options.body: Accept evidence-required jobs and all three providers after exact-head operational verification and stacked-base review.

options.title: Phase legacy enforcement
options.body: Preserve temporary compatibility until existing jobs have replacements and migration and rollback behavior is proven.

options.title: Split remote providers
options.body: Land local digest-bound evidence first and defer cloud and parity operational ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve strict contract
recommendation.body: Accept evidence-required jobs and all three providers after exact-head operational verification and stacked-base review.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the existing importer, remote-provider integration history, and proposed replacement evidence and workflow contract.
